title: Accounting for Partnership: Basic Concepts
description: Basics of partnership deed, Profit & Loss Appropriation Account, partner capital accounts, and interest calculations.

title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm — Admission of a Partner
description: New profit sharing ratio, sacrificing ratio, revaluation of assets and liabilities, and treatment of goodwill on admission.

title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm — Retirement/Death of a Partner
description: Gaining ratio, treatment of goodwill, accumulated profits & reserves, and settlement of deceased partner's executor account.

title: Dissolution of Partnership Firm
description: Realisation account, settlement of accounts, partner's loan, and final capital balance accounts upon firm dissolution.

title: Accounting for Share Capital
description: Issue of shares at par/premium, oversubscription & pro-rata allotment, calls-in-arrears, forfeiture, and reissue of forfeited shares.

title: Issue of Debentures
description: Types of debentures, issue of debentures for consideration other than cash, as collateral security, and writing off discount/loss.

title: Analysis of Financial Statements
description: Financial statements of a company, Comparative statements, Common-size statements, and accounting ratio analysis.

title: Cash Flow Statement
description: Meaning, objectives, classification into Operating, Investing, and Financing activities as per Accounting Standard 3 (AS-3 revised).

title: Unit 1 — National Income and Related Aggregates
description: Macroeconomic aggregates, circular flow of income, GDP, NDP, GNP, NNP at market price and factor cost, Real vs Nominal GDP.

title: Unit 2 — Money and Banking
description: Money meaning and supply (M1), commercial banking credit creation, central bank (RBI) functions, repo rate, reverse repo, CRR, SLR.

title: Unit 3 — Determination of Income and Employment
description: Aggregate demand & supply, propensity to consume/save (APC, MPC, APS, MPS), short-run equilibrium output, investment multiplier, excess & deficient demand.

title: Unit 4 — Government Budget and the Economy
description: Government budget meaning and objectives, Revenue vs Capital receipts/expenditure, Revenue deficit, Fiscal deficit, Primary deficit.

title: Unit 5 — Balance of Payments
description: Balance of Payments account meaning and components (Current vs Capital account), Foreign Exchange Rate (fixed, flexible, managed floating), foreign exchange market.

title: Unit 6 — Development Experience (1947–90) and Economic Reforms since 1991
description: State of Indian economy on the eve of independence, five-year plans goals, agriculture & industry strategies, LPG reforms (LPG policy 1991).

title: Unit 7 — Current Challenges facing Indian Economy
description: Human Capital Formation, Rural Development, Employment & informalisation, Sustainable Economic Development, environment & global warming.

title: Unit 8 — Development Experience of India – A Comparison with Neighbours
description: Comparative development experience of India, China, and Pakistan across economic growth, population, sectoral share, and human development indicators.

title: Relations and Functions
description: Types of relations (reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence), one-one and onto functions, and composition of functions.

title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
description: Definition, range, domain, principal value branches, and graphs of inverse trigonometric functions.

title: Matrices
description: Concept, notation, order, equality, types of matrices, zero and identity matrix, matrix operations, transpose, and symmetric matrices.

title: Determinants
description: Determinant of a square matrix (up to 3x3), minors, cofactors, area of a triangle, adjoint and inverse of a square matrix.

title: Continuity and Differentiability
description: Continuity of functions, chain rule, derivative of implicit functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, and logarithmic differentiation.

title: Application of Derivatives
description: Rate of change of quantities, increasing and decreasing functions, tangents and normals, and maxima and minima.

title: Integrals
description: Integration as inverse process of differentiation, integration by substitution, partial fractions, and fundamental theorem of calculus.

title: Application of Integrals
description: Applications in finding the area under simple curves, lines, circles, parabolas, and ellipses in standard form.

title: Differential Equations
description: Order and degree, general and particular solutions of a differential equation, separation of variables, and linear differential equations.

title: Vector Algebra
description: Vectors and scalars, direction cosines/ratios, position vector, scalar (dot) product and vector (cross) product of vectors.

title: Three Dimensional Geometry
description: Direction cosines and direction ratios of a line joining two points, Cartesian and vector equation of a line, coplanar lines, and shortest distance.

title: Linear Programming
description: Introduction, related terminology such as constraints, objective function, optimization, graphical method of solution for 2-variable LPP.

title: Probability
description: Conditional probability, multiplication theorem on probability, independent events, total probability, and Bayes' theorem.

title: Database Concepts & Relational Data Model
description: Database concepts, relational model, primary/candidate/foreign keys, entity-relationship diagrams, and normalization.

title: Structured Query Language (SQL)
description: Data Definition Language (DDL), Data Manipulation Language (DML), SELECT queries, WHERE filters, GROUP BY, and joins.

title: Computer Networks & Web Security
description: Network topologies (Star, Bus, Ring), LAN/WAN/MAN, TCP/IP, IP addressing, cyber security, firewalls, and encryption.

title: Web Applications & Programming Basics
description: HTML5, CSS basics, web server deployment, client-side vs server-side scripting, and introductory Python/Java algorithms.

title: Nature and Significance of Management
description: Concept, objectives, importance, levels of management, and management as Art, Science, and Profession.

title: Principles of Management
description: Fayol's 14 principles of general management and Taylor's Scientific Management techniques.

title: Business Environment
description: Dimensions of business environment (Economic, Social, Technological, Political, Legal) and Demonetisation.

title: Planning
description: Importance, limitations, planning process, types of plans (Objectives, Strategy, Policy, Procedure, Rule, Budget).

title: Organising
description: Concept, importance, organising process, organizational structure (Functional & Divisional), delegation, and decentralisation.

title: Staffing
description: Concept, importance, staffing process, recruitment sources (Internal & External), selection process, and training & development.

title: Directing
description: Concept, importance, elements of directing (Supervision, Motivation - Maslow's theory, Leadership styles, Communication & barriers).

title: Controlling
description: Concept, importance, relationship between planning and controlling, and controlling process steps.

title: Financial Management
description: Financial decisions (Investment, Financing, Dividend), financial planning, capital structure, and working capital factors.

title: Financial Markets
description: Money market vs Capital market, Primary & Secondary markets, Stock Exchange, trading procedure, and SEBI objectives & functions.

title: Marketing Management
description: Marketing functions, philosophies, 4 Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), branding, packaging, and personal selling.

title: Consumer Protection
description: Importance, Consumer Protection Act 2019 rights & responsibilities, redressal machinery, and remedies available.

title: The Last Lesson
description: Linguistic chauvinism, patriotic devotion, and impact of Franco-Prussian War on Alsace schools by Alphonse Daudet.

title: Lost Spring
description: Stolen childhood and child labor in Seemapuri ragpickers and Firozabad glass bangle industry by Anees Jung.

title: Deep Water
description: Overcoming hydrophobia through grit, willpower, and professional training at YMCA pool by William Douglas.

title: The Rattrap
description: Human essential goodness, metaphor of the world as a rattrap, and moral redemption by Selma Lagerlöf.

title: Indigo
description: Mahatma Gandhi's Champaran satyagraha movement fighting British indigo landlords' exploitation by Louis Fischer.

title: Poets and Pancakes
description: Memoirs of Gemini Studios in Madras, film industry culture, pancake makeup, and Stephen Spender's visit by Asokamitran.

title: The Interview
description: Journalistic interview traditions, celebrity privacy perspectives, and Umberto Eco's academic & novelistic success.

title: Going Places
description: Adolescent daydreams, hero-worship of football star Danny Casey, and conflict between fantasy and reality by A. R. Barton.

title: My Mother at Sixty-Six
description: Emotional complexity of filial bond, aging mother's pale face, and fear of separation by Kamala Das.

title: Keeping Quiet
description: Call for universal stillness, introspective silence, mutual understanding, and peace by Pablo Neruda.

title: A Thing of Beauty
description: Eternal joy of beautiful creations, spiritual solace, and Keats' romantic celebration of nature's endless fountain.

title: A Roadside Stand
description: Economic struggle of rural shed owners, apathy of city elites, and Frost's plea for rural dignity.

title: Aunt Jennifer’s Tigers
description: Patriarchal oppression, marital constraints, and artistic immortality of Aunt Jennifer's proud embroidered tigers.

title: The Third Level
description: Psychological time travel to 1894 Galesburg, Illinois, and modern war anxiety escapism by Jack Finney.

title: The Tiger King
description: Satire on royal arrogance, Maharaja of Pratibandapuram's quest to kill 100 tigers, and irony of fate by Kalki.

title: Journey to the End of the Earth
description: Antarctica scientific expedition, Students on Ice program, climate change, and earth's history by Tishani Doshi.

title: The Enemy
description: Dr. Sadao Hoki's moral dilemma between medical duty/humanity and wartime patriotism by Pearl S. Buck.

title: On the Face of It
description: Unlikely friendship between burn-scarred Derry and optimistic disabled Mr. Lamb by Susan Hill.

title: Memories of Childhood
description: Autobiographical accounts of Native American cultural suppression (Zitkala-Sa) and Indian caste oppression (Bama).
subSections: The Cutting of My Long Hair
